title: God Calls Samuel

questions.question: How often did the Lord’s word come in those days?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:1 (ESV): “...And the word of the Lord was rare in those days; there was no frequent vision.”

questions.question: Who did Samuel think was calling him at night?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:5 (ESV): “And he ran to Eli and said, ‘Here I am, for you called me.’...”

questions.question: What did Eli tell Samuel to say when God called again?
options: Speak, Lord, for your servant hears
questions.correctAnswer: Speak, Lord, for your servant hears
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:9 (ESV): “...if he calls you, you shall say, “Speak, Lord, for your servant hears.”...”

questions.question: What did God tell Samuel about Eli’s house?
options: It would be judged for its iniquity
questions.correctAnswer: It would be judged for its iniquity
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:13 (ESV): “And I declare to him that I am about to punish his house forever... because his sons were blaspheming God...”

questions.question: How did Samuel become known in Israel?
options: As a prophet of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: As a prophet of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:20 (ESV): “And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established as a prophet of the Lord.”

questions.question: How many times did the Lord call Samuel before Eli realized it?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:8 (ESV): "And the LORD called Samuel again the third time... Then Eli perceived that the LORD was calling the boy."

questions.question: Where was Samuel lying down when the Lord called?
options: In the temple of the Lord, where the ark of God was
questions.correctAnswer: In the temple of the Lord, where the ark of God was
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:3 (ESV): "...and Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was."

questions.question: What physical ailment did Eli have?
options: His eyes had begun to grow dim so that he could not see
questions.correctAnswer: His eyes had begun to grow dim so that he could not see
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:2 (ESV): "...whose eyes had begun to grow dim so that he could not see..."

questions.question: Did Samuel hide the vision from Eli?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:18 (ESV): "So Samuel told him everything and hid nothing from him..."

questions.question: How did Eli respond to the message of judgment?
options: It is the Lord. Let him do what seems good to him.
questions.correctAnswer: It is the Lord. Let him do what seems good to him.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:18 (ESV): "...And he said, 'It is the LORD. Let him do what seems good to him.'"

questions.question: God said the ears of everyone who hears the news will ______?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:11 (ESV): "...at which the two ears of everyone who hears it will tingle."

questions.question: What specifically could not atone for the iniquity of Eli's house?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:14 (ESV): "...the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be atoned for by sacrifice or offering forever."

questions.question: Samuel did not yet know the Lord, nor was the ______ of the Lord yet revealed to him.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:7 (ESV): "Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, and the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him."

questions.question: The Lord continued to appear where?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:21 (ESV): "And the LORD appeared again at Shiloh..."

questions.question: The Lord revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh by what means?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 3:21 (ESV): "...for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh by the word of the LORD."

key_verse_text: And the LORD came and stood, calling as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” And Samuel said, “Speak, for your servant hears.” (ESV)
